headline: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
summary: Amazon plans to build a "World Product Graph" indexing all internet products. This project aims to prevent shoppers from leaving Amazon's platform. It will gather data on products even Amazon doesn't sell.

headline: FAA ground stop shuts down flights nationwide
summary: The FAA issued a national ground stop for all US flights due to "extraordinary circumstances". Planes already in the air were allowed to land. A temporary telecommunications outage was cited as the cause.

headline: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
summary: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT Wallet for its AI agents, Dots. It allows AI agents to make purchases for users. Available to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers with eligible US-issued cards.

headline: CMF’s milk carton-shaped Bluetooth speaker is down to a new low price
summary: The unique milk carton-shaped CMF Speaker S is now on sale for $39. This marks a $20 discount and its lowest price yet. The deal is part of Nothing’s early Black Friday promotion.

headline: Blade Runner 2099 Executive Producers Confirm Franchise Owners Are In Talks for "AAA" Video Game Adaptation
summary: Executive producers of Blade Runner 2099 are discussing a AAA video game. Alcon Entertainment co-CEOs confirmed talks for the adaptation. The iconic cyberpunk franchise may expand into high-budget gaming.

headline: PS5 QSSR Updates Revealed for Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, and More
summary: Sony confirmed QSSR support for Marvel's Spider-Man 2 and Arc Raiders. Four other games will also receive QSSR updates. These updates are for base PS5 consoles.

headline: Before Directing the Biggest Success of His Career, Steven Spielberg Almost Made an Alien Horror Movie Instead
summary: Steven Spielberg nearly directed an alien horror film called Night Skies. This project almost happened before his hit movie E.T. The film would have been a darker take on alien encounters.

headline: Kevin Feige Didn't Want Wanda in VisionQuest Because He Was Worried She Would 'Distract' From the Core Show
summary: Kevin Feige preferred Wanda Maximoff not appear in VisionQuest. He feared her presence would distract from the show's core narrative. Paul Bettany, who plays Vision, revealed Feige's concern.

headline: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
summary: The Met Police are investigating David Walliams regarding serious sexual offense allegations. These allegations are distinct from earlier reports by ITV and The Guardian. The investigation is currently ongoing.

headline: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All rescued after cruise ship hit by tanker in New Orleans
summary: All passengers were rescued after a cruise ship collided with a tanker in New Orleans. 32 people were hospitalized with non-critical injuries. No one was reported unaccounted for in the incident.

headline: US Air Force says it responded to 'suspected drones' over RAF Lakenheath
summary: The US Air Force responded to "suspected unauthorized drone activity" over RAF Lakenheath. No injuries or damage were reported from the incident. Investigations into the drone activity are underway.

headline: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage after almost 24 hours of disruption
summary: Microsoft apologized for a global outage lasting nearly 24 hours. The disruption affected various services worldwide. Experts highlight global reliance on major tech providers.
